title: Understanding Model Risk
text: Model risk is the sum of the model variance and the observational variance. It represents the total error in the model's predictions.

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: Adding more features to a model can reduce bias but may increase variance. Consider how this affects the model risk.

title: Calculate New Model Variance
text: Given the new model risk is $$17$$ and the observational variance remains $$3$$, calculate the new model variance.

title: Reasonable Values for New Model
text: With the new model variance calculated, consider how adding features might affect the bias and variance tradeoff.
